brief_description: cocotb 2.0.1 + iverilog 13.0 running the upstream `examples/simple_dff` testbench (a Python-driven D-flip-flop test). FST emitted via cocotb's WAVES=1 + iverilog `-fst`. Distinct from a pure-iverilog VCD in that the trace carries cocotb's auto-injected `cocotb_iverilog_dump` scope alongside the DUT. Exercises the cocotb simulator-origin axis.
anchors: trace ends at ~115,000 ns of simulation time
